name: Construction-Computing Education Map
description: Dataset of higher-education institutions offering programmes in digital construction, BIM, and construction informatics, with programme, cost, accreditation, delivery, and geographic detail. 773 institutions in 58 countries: Europe (324), South America (327), North America (82), Oceania (40).
citation: Construction-Computing Education Map (v1.2.0). CC BY 4.0. <add author / DOI on deposit>.

sourcesOfRecord.note: Primary per-record sources are the institution homepage (`website`) and the programme pages (`programLinks`). No third-party aggregator is treated as authoritative.

coordinates.method: Geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim, then a precision-audit pass that re-queried city-centroid fallbacks with a 25 km distance gate, plus manual verification of unresolved cases. Per-record method recorded in `geoSource`.

geoSourceLegend.nominatim:name+city: resolved to the named institution in its city (campus-level)
geoSourceLegend.nominatim:name: resolved to the named institution (institution-level)
geoSourceLegend.nominatim:name (audited): upgraded from city centroid during the audit pass (campus-level)
geoSourceLegend.nominatim:city: city centroid only — approximate, not the campus location
geoSourceLegend.nominatim:address: geocoded from the street address of the teaching site
geoSourceLegend.manual:campus: manually placed at the teaching campus/site
geoSourceLegend.manual:sede: manually placed at the institution's seat (sede)
geoSourceLegend.manual:city: manually placed at the city — approximate, not the campus location
geoSourceLegend.manual:state capital: placed at the state capital (institution headquarters) — approximate
geoSourceLegend.manual:regional capital: placed at the regional capital — approximate

graduatesPerYear.nature: Values are annual-graduate estimates, expressed as ranges. They are indicative, not official institutional statistics.
graduatesPerYear.imputation: Records originally lacking a figure were imputed from the median of peer institutions in this dataset (same country and institution type where n>=3, widening to type, then to all). Imputed records carry `graduatesEstimated: true`.
graduatesPerYear.note2026-10: 462 records carry 'Not published' (no intake or graduate figure on the programme page); the rest carry ranges, either collected, peer-imputed, or derived from published intake caps.

cost.unit: indicative tuition in each record's costCurrency (local currency; per year unless the record states otherwise in its sources).
cost.note: Ranges run from the lowest to the highest published fee (e.g. home to international). '0' = no tuition charged (e.g. public universities with only administrative/semester contributions). '-' = fee not published by the institution.

legend.1: recently collected, not yet validated against sources
legend.2: cross-referenced with publicly available university sources

topics.note: The topics field uses a controlled vocabulary split into two facets: computingTopics (the digital subject matter) and domains (built-environment context). Each record carries computingTopics and domains as derived subsets of topics.

tagging.rule: Tag a topic only where the institution's own pages show a named course/module or an explicit programme learning outcome; applied uniformly to all institutions.
tagging.interpretation: Tags are confirmed curriculum presence (a floor), not an exhaustive measure; absence = not confirmed from public sources. Documentation bias is a stated limitation.

provenanceFields.lastChecked: ISO date a record's programme/fee data was last verified against source; null = not yet verified in this provenance system

knownLimitations: 294 institutions are pinned to a city/state-capital location rather than the exact campus (geoSource 'nominatim:city', 'manual:city', 'manual:state capital', 'manual:regional capital').
462 graduatesPerYear values are 'Not published'; all graduate figures are indicative, not official statistics.
76 cost values are '-' because the institution does not publish the fee (enquiry-gated, apprenticeship-funded, or price on request).
'0' cost conflates fully free tuition with tuition-free programmes that still charge semester/administrative contributions.
Cost figures are current-year rates and will drift; re-verify against source before citing.
Coverage gaps: Canada, most of South America outside Brazil/Chile/Colombia/Peru, New Zealand and smaller European systems were not swept in the October 2026 gap audit.

validation.method: Stratified random sample (seed=42, region-stratified), each institution checked against its own programme pages under tagging-rubric.md.
validation.censusStatus: In progress (38/309 verified). Sample rate (>50% under-tagged) warrants full verification; CESI campuses corrected via shared national-programme evidence. Priority: <=2-tag population. Records verified under the rubric carry lastChecked. | 2026-07-22: added 21 Chile records (South America pilot), each verified against its own programme page and link-checked; all at verificationLevel 2. | 2026-10-12: gap audit added 18 institutions and new programmes to existing records, each verified against official programme pages; lastChecked set to 2026-10-12 on 39 records.
